verdicts.reason: Both 320x50 banners make the same core mistakes. The legal fine print sits on the left, wrapped into 4 lines and nearly as prominent as the headline, so the hierarchy is wrong. The 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon has shrunk to an illegible sliver under the headline, and the logo and can are reduced to tiny marks. A leaves a clean gutter between the headline and the 'Claim the Deal' button. In B the button is jammed almost against the end of the headline and the ribbon is pushed further right, which makes B more cramped.
